episode.title: The journey of Indian finance

chapters.title: Chapter 10: The Problems of State Power

episode.tagline: Finance is the lifeblood of every economy. India's financial system has taken decades to evolve to where it is today -- and we still have a long way to go. What has this journey been like? What can we learn?
